name: After § 109
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 109a. Highlights that the EU has failed to take meaningful action to protect and advance the strategic, economic and security interests of its Member States in Greenland, despite Greenland’s growing geopolitical importance; deplores the fact that this failure to engage effectively has allowed non-EU powers to expand their presence and influence in the region, thereby confirming once more the EU’s lack of credibility and capacity to act in strategically sensitive areas;
